kiki.mic.probeSub: Getting ready for mic games. About 6 min
kiki.mic.intro: This checks whether mic games can work on this iPhone. Somewhere quiet, about 6 minutes.
kiki.mic.privacy: Only numbers are sent. Never your voice or the words heard.
kiki.mic.againIntro: Picking up from last time. If you’ve just reopened the app, start here.
kiki.mic.perm.how: Tap “Allow” and your iPhone asks whether the mic may be used. Choose “Allow”.
kiki.mic.perm.denied: Not allowed. You can change it in Settings › Safari › Microphone
kiki.mic.again.how: This opens the mic. Tell us whether your iPhone asked for permission again.
kiki.mic.duplex.none: Take your earphones out: this plays through the speaker. A click, then English twice.
kiki.mic.duplex.wired: Put on wired earphones. English plays twice.
kiki.mic.duplex.bluetooth: Put on wireless earphones such as AirPods. English plays twice.
kiki.mic.whisper.none: The model isn't on the site yet.
kiki.mic.whisper.how: Downloads the speech model (about {mb} MB) and tries transcribing on this iPhone. Wi-Fi recommended.
kiki.mic.whisper.local: Your voice never leaves this iPhone.
kiki.mic.whisper.clips: Trying the model on our clips ({dev}, {n} / 3)
kiki.mic.relay: Speech to text on the server
kiki.mic.relay.disclose: Your voice goes to the server only while it’s transcribed, and isn’t kept.
kiki.mic.say.how: Read the English below out loud ({n} / 3)
kiki.mic.result.queued: They’ll go when you’re back online
kiki.mic.result.reopen: One last thing: close the app, reopen it, and open this check again.
kiki.mic.row.speaker: Speaker
kiki.mic.title: Mic
kiki.mic.unsupported: This browser can't use the mic
kiki.mic.rule: Nothing is recorded to keep or sent; it's gone when the game ends. Earphones recommended.
kiki.mic.check.how: Tap the button and say something in English.
kiki.mic.be.auto.say: Transcribed on this iPhone. Your voice never leaves it.
kiki.mic.be.whisper.say: Transcribed on this iPhone (Whisper). Your voice never leaves it.
kiki.mic.be.webkit.say: Uses Safari's recognition. Your voice may be sent to Apple.
kiki.mic.be.relay.say: Your voice goes to our server only while it's transcribed, and isn't kept.
kiki.mic.be.cant: Not available on this device now
kiki.mic.model.how: A download of about {mb} MB. Wi-Fi recommended.
kiki.mic.model.fail: Couldn't download. Try again with a better connection
kiki.mic.reply.unsure: That might work too. Which would you pick?
kiki.mic.reply.capped: That's all for today (the server's limit). Tap to choose
kiki.mic.reply.other: Couldn't make that out. Tap to choose
